title: The Sigil of Highmoor
author: Zephyrine Vasquez
blurb: Dominic Dravenmoor, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
